name: drawguess
description: DrawGuess - real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing game

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @drawguess/server" "npm run dev -w @drawguess/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @drawguess/server && npm run build -w @drawguess/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @drawguess/shared && npm run typecheck -w @drawguess/server && npm run typecheck -w @drawguess/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @drawguess/shared && npm run test -w @drawguess/server && npm run test -w @drawguess/web
